name: 流式审核抽检 — 抽检复核不同意并改判
description: 验证抽检人判定'不正确'时可当场改判（改判通过/驳回、调整类目、修改选图），修正结果回写覆盖原审核任务。

steps.expression: (() => { const viewBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a, button, span, [cursor=pointer]')).filter(e => e.textContent.includes('查看详情') || (e.textContent.includes('查看') && !e.textContent.includes('任务进度'))); if (viewBtns[0]) { viewBtns[0].click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, note: '无待抽检任务' }; })()
steps.description: 点击第一条待抽检任务

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const incorrectBtn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, [role=button], span, label, .ant-radio-wrapper, .ant-checkbox-wrapper')).find(e => e.textContent.includes('不正确') || e.textContent.includes('不同意')); const hasRejectOptions = text.includes('改判') || text.includes('驳回') || text.includes('通过') || text.includes('调整'); return { hasIncorrectButton: !!incorrectBtn, incorrectBtnText: incorrectBtn ? incorrectBtn.textContent.trim() : null, hasRejectOptions, pagePreview: text.substring(0, 500) }; })()
steps.description: 验证'不正确'选项存在及改判能力

_testDesign.preconditions: 存在待抽检的流式拦截任务
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.打开抽检任务 2.查看详情 3.验证'不正确'选项及改判能力
_testDesign.expectedResult: 抽检人可判定'不正确'并执行改判操作
_testDesign.dbAssertion: spot_check_record: is_consistent=false; 原审核任务auditOption被覆盖为改判结果
riskPoints: 改判操作的具体UI交互需实际页面确认
_testDesign.prdMapping: 抽检执行与改判处理 - 当场改判
